features.title: Core job search with AI-powered semantic matching
acceptance: Backend serves /api/search endpoint accepting query, location, filters
Frontend search page renders results with pagination
Semantic matching uses sentence-transformers for query-job embedding similarity
Results include AI match score and explanation

features.title: Dictionary coverage checker for skills/roles/industries
acceptance: Three result types: canonical hit, alias hit, miss
Misses recorded with deduplication counter for admin review

features.title: Anonymous application process sharing with k-anonymity
acceptance: Stage timing and outcome distributions displayed
